c74object.name: j.oscroute
c74object.description: j.oscroute lets you route both relative and absolute osc addresses. It also offers to use wilcard to match addresses containing a variable node of instance number

objarg.name: address pattern
objarg.description: One or many arguments to j.oscroute set the address pattern(s) to route incoming addresses

method.name: anything
method.digest: Osc address and optional value to route
method.description: A symbol defining an osc address followed by an optional value get routed out to the matching outlet

method.name: bang
method.description: A bang is passed on like any other value.

method.name: float
method.description: The number is passed on like any other value.

method.name: int
method.description: The integer is passed on like any other value.

method.name: list
method.description: The list is passed on like any other value.
